neutralDescription.en: The night patrol at Perzel Farm
neutralDescription.pt: A patrulha noturna na Perzel Farm

neutralDescription.en: Starting the reporters' escort (talk to Verne at Hotel Rolent)
neutralDescription.pt: Começar a escolta dos repórteres (falar com o Verne no Hotel Rolent)

neutralDescription.en: Wrapping up the robbery investigation with Scherazard
neutralDescription.pt: Encerrar a investigação do roubo com a Scherazard

neutralDescription.en: The event marker deep in Mistwald (end of the Prologue)
neutralDescription.pt: O marcador de evento no fundo de Mistwald (fim do Prólogo)

location.en: Rolent — Carl, behind the Orbal Factory
location.pt: Rolent — Carl, atrás da Orbal Factory

hint.en: 2 BP. Check the steam from the drain cover near Rinon's General Goods, then take the sewer entrance behind the chapel and find the shiny stone. Eat the Drill Meatballs you get for the recipe.
hint.pt: 2 BP. Veja o vapor saindo do bueiro perto da Rinon's General Goods, depois entre no esgoto pelos fundos da capela e ache a pedra brilhante. Coma as Drill Meatballs que você ganha para aprender a receita.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Prologue - Day 2

location.en: Milch Main Road — middle of the road
location.pt: Milch Main Road — meio da estrada

hint.en: 3 BP. Weak to fire. It explodes when it dies, so keep the party out of range for the last hit.
hint.pt: 3 BP. Fraco contra fogo. Ele explode ao morrer, então deixe a equipe fora do alcance no golpe final.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Prologue - Day 2

hint.en: 3 BP. The glowing Firefly Mushroom is near the Silver Earrings chest at the northeast end of Malga Trail; picking it starts a fight.
hint.pt: 3 BP. O Firefly Mushroom brilhante fica perto do baú das Silver Earrings, no extremo nordeste da Malga Trail; pegá-lo começa uma luta.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Prologue - Day 3

location.en: Rolent — Freddy at the Orbment Shop
location.pt: Rolent — Freddy na loja de orbments

hint.en: 3 (+1) BP. The broken light is in the middle of Milch Main Road. For the bonus, let Joshua fight and have Estelle enter the code: the 3rd option (544818). Rewards Impede 2.
hint.pt: 3 (+1) BP. A luz quebrada fica no meio da Milch Main Road. Para o bônus, deixe o Joshua lutar e faça a Estelle digitar o código: a 3ª opção (544818). Dá Impede 2.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Prologue - Day 3

hint.en: 3 BP. Bring a Bear Claw (southeast end of Mistwald) and Monster Powder (Killer Hornets in Mistwald). Mistwald only has four Bear Claws: don't cook them all.
hint.pt: 3 BP. Leve uma Bear Claw (extremo sudeste de Mistwald) e Monster Powder (Killer Hornets em Mistwald). Mistwald só tem quatro Bear Claws: não cozinhe todas.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Prologue - Day 2
guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Prologue - Day 3

location.en: Verte Bridge — Chief Warrant Officer Ashton
location.pt: Verte Bridge — Chief Warrant Officer Ashton

hint.en: 2 (+2) BP. Win the training fight against two soldiers for the bonus; save first. Their attacks lower Defense: Estelle's Morale helps.
hint.pt: 2 (+2) BP. Vença a luta de treino contra dois soldados para o bônus; salve antes. Os ataques deles reduzem a defesa: o Morale da Estelle ajuda.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Prologue - Day 3

hint.en: 2 BP. Short deadline: do it right away. The cat isn't marked: look between the clock tower, near Elger Arms & Guards, by Hotel Rolent, then upstairs in the chapel.
hint.pt: 2 BP. Prazo curto: faça na hora. O gato não aparece no mapa: procure entre a torre do relógio, perto da Elger Arms & Guards, junto ao Hotel Rolent e, por fim, no andar de cima da capela.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Prologue - Day 3

hint.en: 4 BP. It blocks the bridge to your next destination, so you can't skip it. Wear Sleep protection; weak to fire.
hint.pt: 4 BP. Ele bloqueia a ponte para o próximo destino, então não dá para pular. Use proteção contra Sleep; fraco contra fogo.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Prologue - Day 3

name.en: Bonus BP: storming into Esmelas Tower
name.pt: BP bônus: entrar na Esmelas Tower

hint.en: +1 BP (Child Rescue). The choice comes right as you enter: pick the 2nd option, storming in together with Joshua.
hint.pt: +1 BP (Child Rescue). A escolha aparece logo ao entrar: escolha a 2ª opção, entrar junto com o Joshua.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Prologue - Day 1

name.en: Bonus BP: sneaking up on the crop thief
name.pt: BP bônus: chegar de surpresa no ladrão de plantações

hint.en: +2 BP (Perzel Pest Control). After the stables and the greenhouse, sneak up behind the monster without entering its line of sight, and examine it. Save first.
hint.pt: +2 BP (Perzel Pest Control). Depois do estábulo e da estufa, chegue por trás do monstro sem entrar no campo de visão dele e examine-o. Salve antes.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Prologue - Day 2

name.en: Bonus BP: the four robbery questions
name.pt: BP bônus: as quatro perguntas do roubo

hint.en: +4 BP (Mayoral Robbery), one per right answer: 2nd, 2nd, 3rd, 4th.
hint.pt: +4 BP (Mayoral Robbery), um por resposta certa: 2ª, 2ª, 3ª, 4ª.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Prologue - Day 3

name.en: Bonus BP: the choice in Mistwald
name.pt: BP bônus: a escolha em Mistwald

hint.en: +1 BP (Mayoral Robbery). Pick the 2nd option during the event. The boss right after is much harder than in the original: bring Earth Guard.
hint.pt: +1 BP (Mayoral Robbery). Escolha a 2ª opção durante o evento. O chefe logo depois é bem mais difícil que no original: leve Earth Guard.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Prologue - Day 3

location.pt: Rolent — casa a noroeste, andar de cima

hint.en: Talk to Rhett. The Carnelia volumes are traded together for Estelle and Joshua's best weapons late in the game. A missed volume can later be bought, at a high price.
hint.pt: Fale com o Rhett. Os volumes de Carnelia são trocados juntos pelas melhores armas da Estelle e do Joshua no fim do jogo. Um volume perdido pode ser comprado depois, por um preço alto.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Prologue - Day 1

hint.en: Read the diary on the table in Luke's room.
hint.pt: Leia o diário sobre a mesa do quarto do Luke.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Prologue - Day 1

hint.en: Bought during a story scene: you can't miss it.
hint.pt: Comprado durante uma cena da história: não tem como perder.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Prologue - Day 1

hint.en: Eat each dish once to learn its recipe.
hint.pt: Coma cada prato uma vez para aprender a receita.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Prologue - Day 1
guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Prologue - Day 2

text.en: Maple Cookie — story scene at Rinon's General Goods
text.pt: Maple Cookie — cena da história na Rinon's General Goods

text.en: Drill Meatballs — Shiny Stone Search reward
text.pt: Drill Meatballs — recompensa da Shiny Stone Search

text.en: Dreamy Shell Bake — chest on Esmelas Tower 3F
text.pt: Dreamy Shell Bake — baú no 3F da Esmelas Tower

text.en: Salad Sandwich — Emily at Gurune Gate
text.pt: Salad Sandwich — Emily no Gurune Gate

hint.en: The first dungeon, during Retrieval Training.
hint.pt: A primeira dungeon, durante a Retrieval Training.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Prologue - Day 1

hint.en: A hidden cave west of the Droplet of Life is a great early grinding spot.
hint.pt: Uma caverna escondida a oeste do Droplet of Life é um ótimo lugar para treinar cedo.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Prologue - Day 1
guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Prologue - Day 2

hint.en: Both monster chests hold Wind Trappers that are very hard before level 8 and explode when defeated. You come back here in the story, so they can wait.
hint.pt: Os dois baús de monstros têm Wind Trappers muito difíceis antes do nível 8, que explodem ao serem derrotados. Você volta aqui na história, então eles podem esperar.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Prologue - Day 2

text.pt: 3F — Monk's Staff (baú de monstros: Wind Trapper ×3)
4F — Green Sphere (baú de monstros: Wind Trapper ×3)

hint.en: Black Bangle and Beast Hide Jumpsuit are big early upgrades, with no monster chests.
hint.pt: Black Bangle e Beast Hide Jumpsuit são grandes melhorias no começo, sem baús de monstros.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Prologue - Day 2

hint.en: The side path that Joshua blocks on Day 1 opens on Day 2.
hint.pt: O caminho lateral que o Joshua bloqueia no Dia 1 abre no Dia 2.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Prologue - Day 1
guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Prologue - Day 2

hint.en: One monster chest with Lily Movers. A Shining Pom can spawn near the first Rhinocider.
hint.pt: Um baú de monstros com Lily Movers. Um Shining Pom pode aparecer perto do primeiro Rhinocider.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Prologue - Day 2

text.en: Laced Boots (monster chest: Lily Mover+ ×3, Lily Mover ×3)
text.pt: Laced Boots (baú de monstros: Lily Mover+ ×3, Lily Mover ×3)

strategy.en: Weak to fire. It explodes on defeat (up to 800 damage on high difficulties): keep the party away for the final blow.
strategy.pt: Fraco contra fogo. Explode ao ser derrotado (até 800 de dano nas dificuldades altas): mantenha a equipe longe no golpe final.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Prologue - Day 2

strategy.en: Teaches Overdrive: turn it on and chain Brave Attacks. Fire arts work well; it powers up by eating its apple.
strategy.pt: Ensina o Overdrive: ative e encadeie Brave Attacks. Arts de fogo funcionam bem; ele fica mais forte comendo a maçã.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Prologue - Day 2

strategy.en: Their hits lower Defense; Estelle's Morale counters it, and Overdrive ends the fight fast.
strategy.pt: Os golpes deles reduzem a defesa; o Morale da Estelle compensa, e o Overdrive encerra a luta rápido.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Prologue - Day 3

strategy.en: Tanky but weak to fire. Spread out (its hits splash) and wear Sleep protection.
strategy.pt: Resistente, mas fraco contra fogo. Espalhe a equipe (os golpes atingem em área) e use proteção contra Sleep.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Prologue - Day 3

strategy.en: Much harder than the original. Bring Earth Guard, take out the bandits first with Schera's wind arts, impede Josette's casts and dispel her Rage buff with Anti-Sept or Joshua's Sever.
strategy.pt: Bem mais difícil que no original. Leve Earth Guard, derrube os bandidos primeiro com as arts de vento da Schera, interrompa as conjurações da Josette e remova o buff de Rage com Anti-Sept ou o Sever do Joshua.

sources: guide: Neoseeker FC walkthrough, Prologue - Day 3
